name: Panasonic ducted system
tagline: R32 ducted air conditioning with nanoe X air purification and smart control.
summary: Panasonic's R32 ducted range hides the indoor unit in the ceiling and suits homes with many rooms as well as light commercial buildings.
High static pressure models run from 6.0 kW to 22.4 kW, with nanoe X air purification standard on the 6.0 kW to 16.0 kW models.

image.alt: Panasonic ducted system indoor unit, outdoor unit and wall controller

highlights.title: nanoe X air purification
highlights.text: Sends hydroxyl radicals through the ducts to inhibit airborne and adhered bacteria and viruses.

highlights.title: DRED ready
highlights.text: A built-in Demand Response Enabling Device complies with AS 4755.

highlights.title: Quiet mode
highlights.text: Quiet mode reduces outdoor operating sound by 2 dB.

highlights.title: Smart control
highlights.text: Control from anywhere with the Panasonic Comfort Cloud app and an optional network adaptor.

highlights.title: Compact outdoor units
highlights.text: Side-discharge R32 outdoor units are smaller, so they fit into tighter spaces.

highlights.title: Fewer cold drafts
highlights.text: Accurate temperature sensing reduces cold drafts during heating.

specs.label: Max. piping length
specs.value: 50 m to 85 m, depending on capacity
